title: The riot package API
text: public API deliberately small: two exported functions. read_bundle(file, reference_file = NULL, bundle_data = list()) reads tractography file returns bundle (single streamline file contains exactly one tract). supported extensions declared internal supported_formats(): Dispatch file extension: .vtk, .vtp, .fds — C++ readers ReadVTK(), ReadVTP(), ReadFDS(); .tck — read_mrtrix(); .trk — read_trk(); .trx, .fib, .dpy — DIPY Python bridge reticulate. DIPY-backed formats, read_bundle() requires reference_file initialises Python bridge internal check_dipy() helper. write_bundle(x, file, reference_file = NULL) writes bundle (single streamline) file, invisibly returning x can used pipes. target format chosen file extension file.

title: The riot package API
text: internal (non-exported) API C++ layer format readers built . C++ functions know S7 objects. exchange data flat named list columns: X, Y, Z — point coordinates; PointId — 1-based position point within streamline; StreamlineId — 1-based identifier streamline. Additional columns hold per-point scalar attributes. Columns named streamline_cols treated per-streamline attributes instead. Two internal functions convert two representations: flat_list_to_bundle(lst, streamline_cols = character(0)) — converts flat list returned ReadVTK(), ReadVTP(), ReadFDS(), TCK/TRK readers streamline bundle; bundle_to_flat_list(x) — converts bundle streamline back flat list expected WriteVTK(), WriteVTP(), WriteFDS(). conversion O(points) rather O(streamlines × points): uses split(seq_along(sid), sid) group point indices per streamline instead scanning points streamline. matters TRK reader, can process hundreds thousands points. read_mrtrix() handles .tck .tsf files. split : read_header() — parses text header derives data offset, endianness, element size; read_tck() — reads binary track data, using NaN separators streamlines Inf terminator end; read_tsf() — reads track-scalar data, matching scalars streamlines. read_mrtrix() merges .tsf scalar columns tracks timestamps, streamline counts, point counts match. read_trk() reads binary TrackVis format. uses read_fixed_char_binary() null-terminated header strings retrieve_trk_endianness() detect big/little endian checking hdr_size field (1000 bytes) offset 996. bulk parsing happens C++ function ReadTRK(), reads whole file body single fread() call pre-allocates output vectors counting pass.
code: flat <- riot:::bundle_to_flat_list(b) names(flat)[1:5] #> [1] "X"            "Y"            "Z"            "PointId"      "StreamlineId"

title: Importing and exporting bundles with riot
text: {riot} (R Inputs/Outputs Tractography) reads writes tractography data: bundles streamlines (3-D polylines) reconstructed fibre-tracking algorithms applied diffusion MRI data. input/output layer {tractoverse} package family. central functions : read_bundle() — import bundle file one supported formats; write_bundle() — export bundle file. Bundles live R S7 classes streamline bundle defined {fiber} package: streamline holds one fibre tract: @points n×3n \times 3 numeric matrix columns X, Y, Z; @point_data named list per-point scalar attributes (e.g. fractional anisotropy sampled every point); @streamline_data named list per-streamline scalars (e.g. tract-level weight); bundle ordered collection streamlines @streamlines, plus optional bundle-level metadata @bundle_data. read_bundle() returns single streamline file contains exactly one tract bundle otherwise.

title: R Inputs/Outputs for Tractography
text: riot (R Input/Output Tractography) package provides R interface importing exporting tractography data R. Currently supported importing formats : native VTK .vtk .vtp files; medInria .fds files; MRtrix .tck/.tsf files; TrackVis .trk files; , TrackVis .trx, DIPY .dpy, .fib files ‘DIPY’ Python library. package reads tractography data S7 objects defined {fiber} package: streamline — single fibre tract stored three typed slots: @points (n×3n \times 3 matrix columns X, Y, Z), @point_data (named list per-point numeric vectors, e.g. diffusion metrics sampled every point), @streamline_data (named list per-streamline scalar attributes). bundle — ordered collection streamline objects @streamlines, plus optional bundle-level metadata @bundle_data. read_bundle() returns streamline file contains single tract bundle otherwise. optional bundle_data argument lets attach named list bundle-level metadata (e.g. subject ID, hemisphere, affine transform) directly import time: list stored @bundle_data slot returned bundle. package also allows write bundles back following exporting formats: native VTK .vtk .vtp files; , medInria .fds files; .trk, .tck, .trx, .fib, .dpy files ‘DIPY’ Python library (requires reference image). guided tour package available vignette("riot") vignette, internal design described developer-oriented vignette("riot-api") vignette.

text: C++ source files renamed: fascicle* → bundle*. src/fascicleReaders.{cpp,h} src/fascicleWriters.{cpp,h} renamed src/bundleReaders.{cpp,h} src/bundleWriters.{cpp,h} align bundle terminology used throughout package API. include guards updated accordingly (_BUNDLEREADERS_H, _BUNDLEWRITERS_H). functional change.

title: riot 1.2.0
text: TRK reader now dramatically faster (~20× real-world data). Two bottlenecks removed: /O layer: old read_trk() called readBin() twice per streamline (num_points, point block), causing 2 × N sequential file reads. new C++ function ReadTRK() replaces R loop: reads entire file body single fread() call, makes two fast -memory passes — one count total points pre-allocate output vectors, one parse coordinates scalars using direct memcpy-based reads optional byte-swapping. Bundle assembly: flat_list_to_bundle() previously evaluated sid == inside loop streamlines, making conversion O(streamlines × points). now calls split(seq_along(sid), sid) (C-level operation, O(points)) compute per-streamline index vectors front. fix also benefits VTK/VTP/FDS readers, share conversion function.

title: riot 1.2.0
text: Windows R CMD check fix: quarto CLI TMPDIR error. R-CMD-check workflow now sets QUARTO_PATH=nonexistent Windows running check. quarto R package calls system2("quarto", "-V", env = paste0("TMPDIR=", …)), Windows passes env assignment positional argument CLI rather setting environment variable, causing ERROR: Unknown command "TMPDIR=…". Setting QUARTO_PATH nonexistent value makes find_quarto() return NULL immediately, system2 never called. Windows R CMD check fix: VTK symbols undefined / linker failures. configure, configure.win, cleanup, cleanup.win, src/Makevars.removed. replaced static src/Makevars uses POSIX backtick syntax (per Writing R Extensions) call tools/configure.R directly compile time: tools/configure.R calls rvtk::CppFlags() rvtk::LdFlagsFile(path = "vtk_libs.rsp") (modules argument). LdFlagsFile() writes complete list static VTK libraries src/vtk_libs.rsp returns @vtk_libs.rsp, linker reads directly — avoiding Windows command-line length limits. modules argument dropped rvtk:::filter_libs() matches module names directly .filenames: Windows files named libvtkIOLegacy-9.5.module names "VTK_IOLegacy" (uppercase prefix + underscore), none matched .rsp file contained VTK libraries. macOS/Linux system VTK (e.g. homebrew), filter_libs called, modules -op anyway. macOS R CMD check fix: _NSEventTrackingRunLoopMode found. tools/configure.R calls rvtk::LdFlagsFile() explicit modules argument, linking VTK /O Common modules riot actually uses. Previously, rvtk fell back pre-built static bundle (case CRAN binary macOS CI), -Wl,-all_load forced every symbol every .— including rendering modules reference _NSEventTrackingRunLoopMode AppKit.framework — riot., causing dlopen() fail check time.
code: PKG_CPPFLAGS = `"$(R_HOME)/bin/Rscript" ../tools/configure.R --cppflags` PKG_LIBS     = `"$(R_HOME)/bin/Rscript" ../tools/configure.R --libs`

title: riot 1.2.0
text: Breaking change: read_tractogram() write_tractogram() renamed read_bundle() write_bundle() consistency bundle data model.

title: riot 1.2.0
text: optional DIPY Python dependency now declared via reticulate::py_require("dipy") (reticulate ≥ 1.41) instead previous manual py_module_available() check. Reticulate automatically provision DIPY ephemeral virtual environment one DIPY-backed formats (.trx, .fib, .dpy) first used.

what: S7 data model: streamline and bundle classes moved to {fiber}
title: riot 1.2.0
text: @points: n×3n \times 3 numeric matrix columns "X", "Y", "Z" ordered coordinates nn points along tract. PointId implicit row order longer stored. @point_data: named list numeric vectors length nn, holding per-point scalar attributes (e.g. fractional anisotropy point). @streamline_data: named list numeric scalars (length-1 vectors) holding per-streamline attributes (e.g. tract-level weight mean FA). @streamlines: list streamline objects. StreamlineId implicit list position longer stored. @bundle_data: named list bundle-level metadata (e.g. affine transform used tracking). riot longer depends S7 directly; S7 classes, constructors, predicates, methods (streamline(), is_streamline(), bundle(), is_bundle(), format(), print(), length(), [[, [, …) provided fiber re-exported . riot now imports fiber instead S7. read_bundle() returns streamline file contains exactly one tract, bundle otherwise. write_bundle() accepts streamline bundle objects. readr package longer dependency.

what: C++ layer: elimination of intermediate CSV files
title: riot 1.2.0
text: Breaking change (internal): C++ reader functions (ReadVTK, ReadVTP, ReadFDS) longer write temporary CSV file. now return cpp11::writable::list directly R, eliminating temporary file /O associated string-reference issues. C++ writer functions (WriteVTK, WriteVTP, WriteFDS) longer read temporary CSV. now accept cpp11::list directly R. helper WriteCSV (vtkPolyData → CSV) ReadCSV (CSV → vtkPolyData) replaced PolyDataToList ListToPolyData respectively, operating entirely memory.

title: riot 1.2.0
text: VTK discovery, compilation flags, pre-built static library distribution now handled entirely rvtk package (now CRAN). rvtk supplies pre-compiled VTK headers libraries manual VTK installation required platforms: honours user-supplied VTK_DIR environment variable first, tries Homebrew (macOS), pkg-config (macOS/Linux), well-known system prefixes; Windows checks VTK_DIR, Rtools45 pacman, common MSYS2 prefixes; suitable system VTK found downloads pre-built static libraries automatically rvtk GitHub releases. rvtk listed Imports dependency; downstream packages longer need locate VTK .
